title: Modernizing forecasting across organizational boundaries
summary: A historical retail case study in translating source semantics, reconstructing demand history, and replacing manual replenishment with governed forecasting, audit, and ordering workflows.

title: Moving enterprise analytics to a governed cloud data platform
summary: A historical modernization case study in source-key analysis, change detection, reconciliation, access governance, and operational confidence during a Teradata-to-BigQuery transition.

title: Designing reconciliation for systems that disagree
summary: A reusable data-quality pattern for preserving conflicting evidence, testing business state and time, and recovering safely when schema-valid records describe incompatible realities.

title: Measuring whether incident evidence can be trusted
summary: A research-to-practice pattern that evaluates gaps, delays, contradictions, provenance, and recovery in the telemetry used for incident analysis.

title: Building controls around AI-assisted data decisions
summary: A governance pattern that keeps context, provenance, uncertainty, ownership, validation, and human review visible around AI-assisted standardization.
